paragraphs.text: Saffi Eriksdotter was a Balduvian scout who lived in the Ice Age on Dominaria . She was killed by a Lhurgoyf .
Saffi was the sister of Hans Eriksson , who managed to escape from the attack to warn the other villagers.
The flavor text of the Secret Lair Sun Titan found in Artist Series: Jesper Ejsing implies that a Sun Titan revived Saffi some time after her death.

Lhurgoyf ( Ice Age )'s flavor text has become iconic and is referenced on multiple cards. Unfinity s Killer Cosplay quotes the bearfolk guest Steffi Bobsdotter, while Edge of Eternities s Cosmogoyf references the spacecraft PSS Erix .
